botswana.overview: The Okavango Delta is not a traditional hiking destination, but guided bush walks on its islands track wildlife on foot. Camps are reached by small plane or helicopter, and independent walking is not permitted because of dangerous animals.

months.4: Rains ease and temperatures cool, allowing guided island walks to resume more comfortably.
months.5: The bush is drying out and temperatures are cool, making guided island walks more comfortable.
months.9: Vegetation is sparse, offering the best visibility for spotting wildlife on guided bush walks.
months.10: Vegetation is still sparse and the heat is building, but visibility for spotting wildlife on guided bush walks stays excellent.
months.11: The first rains of the year thicken the vegetation, making walking hotter and wildlife harder to spot.
months.12: Heat and the early rains thicken the vegetation, leaving walks hotter and wildlife harder to spot.
